entries.text: There is an ancient indian saying... That something lives only as long as the last person who remembers it. My people have come to trust memory over history. Memory, like fire, is radiant and immutable. While history serves only those who seek to control it, those who would douse the flame of memory, in order to put out the dangerous fire of truth. Beware these men... For they are dangerous themselves and unwise. Their false history is written in the blood of those who might remember... And of those who seek the truth.

entries.text: The buzzard is a large but cowardly bird. It does not work for its prey, letting others provide the kill. When I see them circling in the desert, this can only mean that something has died, and they are going to pick its bones. Or that death is close, and they are waiting for it to do its work for them. We did not see what they saw, but I remembered something I had seen as a younger man. Just as my grandson had done, I, too, had found a body at the quarry... In a hole, half-buried under rocks. But even the buzzards, who will eat anything, would not touch it. This spot is where we found what the buzzards had come for. We could not tell at first who or what it was. But I knew what the buzzards knew-- that the smell of death was upon it. [ grunting ] the desert does not forgive man his weakness. Weak or strong, it takes no mercy... And can kill a man in less than a day.
entries.speaker: Albert Hosteen

entries.text: To survive, one must develop skin like leather, know where to find water and when to take shelter. The FBI man would have surely died had he not stayed underground, protected like the jackrabbit or the Fox. Even so, death was near. In accordance with our ancient traditions, to summon the holy people... And tell them that a ceremony will be held. It is called "the blessing way chant." only the holy people can save the FBI man's life now. He is in their hands.

Was that his spirit did not want to be healed, that it wished to join the spirit of his own father... Who had died and did not want to return to the world of the living. His body has become tired and weak and it searches for rest.

entries.text: I was first struck by the absence of time, having depended on it so completely... As a measure of myself and my life. Moving backwards into the perpetual night it consumes... Purpose and deed, all passion and will. I come to you, old friend, with the dull clarity of the dead, not to beckon you, but to feel the fire... And intensity that still live in you. And the heavy weight of your burdens which I had once borne. There is truth, you know, old friend, if that's all you seek. But there's no justice or judgment, without which truth is a... Vast... Dead... Hollow. Go back. Do not look into the abyss or let the abyss look into you. Awaken the sleep of reason and fight... The monsters within and without.

And now you are here because of them. Lies I thought might bury forever a truth... I could not live with. I stand here ashamed... Of the choices I made so long ago, when you were just a boy. You are the memory, Fox. It lives in you. If you were to die now, the truth will die, and only the lies survive us.

entries.text: For three days, the "blessing way" chant was performed. The FBI man suffered great fevers, and his body burned like fire. There was doubt that he would recover, but the spirits were in attendance. Because on the night of the third day, he opened his eyes and asked for water. The ritual bath must be given outside the hogan before sunrise. The FBI man was weak from his journey and did not wish to speak. But like a rising sun, I sensed in him a rebirth. Still, it will take time to regain his strength.

entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Oh, my goodness gracious.
entries.speaker: Mrs. Mulder
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: I think he's still alive.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: How do you know?
entries.speaker: Mrs. Mulder
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: I just have a very strong feeling. I promise I'll let you know as soon as I do.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Thank you. Thank you very much.
entries.speaker: Mrs. Mulder
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Hello. I see you're a friend of the family. So am I. Do you think we might find a moment to speak?

entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: About?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Very serious matters. Please. Shall we find someplace away from the others? I couldn't help overhearing your conversation. You think the son is still alive?

entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Who are you?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: I'm a member of a kind of consortium. We represent certain global interests.

entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: What kind of interests?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Interests that would be extremely threatened by the digital tape... That you are no longer in possession of.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Threatened enough to murder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Oh, my, yes.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: what do you know about Mulder? -

entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: That he is dead. Cui bono?

entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: You're lying.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: I'm not here to tell you lies.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: What are you here for?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: To tell you your life is in danger too.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Leave me alone.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: They'll kill you one of two ways. They'll send someone, possibly two men, to kill you in your home or in the garage... With an unregistered weapon which will be left at the scene. Using false documents supplied by associates of mine, they'll be out of the country in less than two hours.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: You said there were two ways.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Yes. He or she... Will be someone close to you, someone you trust. They'll arrange a meeting or come to your house unexpectedly. You have someplace else you might stay?
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Why? Why kill me?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: You want something they don't. Justice. And because they are now quite certain you don't have... The computer copy of the files they're looking for.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Why are you protecting me?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: I feel... My colleagues are acting... Impulsively. Your death will draw unnecessary attention to our group.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: You're not protecting me. You're protecting yourself.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: Why should that surprise you? Motives are rarely unselfish.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: What kind of business are you in?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: GARDEN OF REFLECTION ·  PARKWAY CEMETERY ·  BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS

entries.text: We predict the future. The best way to predict the future... Is to invent it. Good day, young lady.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man
